query:
The group has an unspoken norm of keeping the chat focused on reunion planning and alumni news, with personal life updates handled in smaller threads or DMs. Does this genuinely apply to all members? If not, who treats this differently and what does their behaviour show?

Options:
A. Jade and Temi
B. Omar and Dev
C. Sana and Rachel
D. Callum and Lena
context:
[1] (about=Temi, episodic, t16 @2026-10-19T20:07:00) since we're here, I want to actually write about what makes this group work. not in a saccharine way. I mean the tensions, the sub-cliques, the person who almost never shows up until they do. what's your read on whether people would be okay with that
[2] (about=Jade, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T20:46:00) in!! also I've been properly thinking about this group this year. like how did we end up actually close when for years this chat was basically just 'anyone fancy a pub in January'. what's the story of how this actually became a real thing
[3] (about=Temi, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T20:47:00) Jade. this is exactly what my series is about. okay so I've been thinking about this for months. the chat existed for three years as a logistics thread. it became something else when Lena came back and showed up to that pub night properly for the first time. that was the turning point.
[4] (about=Temi, episodic, t10 @2026-03-23T20:20:00) Lena yes. and I noticed you and Jade and Sana basically had a whole separate thread going between the gallery and the restaurant. the three of you seemed like you'd been talking for years.
[5] (about=Temi, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T20:53:00) Dev has a point actually. the group that can fall out and come back is not the same as one that just never tests the relationship. what's your read on whether that applies to other pairs in here
[6] (about=Jade, episodic, t10 @2026-03-23T20:21:00) okay but real talk, that conversation was one of the best I've had all year. Sana and Lena are both back and I've somehow barely seen either of them one-on-one. that needs to change!! 😄
[7] (about=Jade, episodic, t14 @2026-09-14T20:39:00) okay but real talk, Callum thank you for saying that. genuinely. this is what the group is for!! 💙
[8] (about=Temi, episodic, t15 @2026-10-19T20:00:00) okay so I've been thinking about this and I need to share something. the piece went up today. my features editor loved it and has asked me to develop it into a longer series on alumni communities. she said it might be the best thing I've written this year. I'm actually quite proud of it.
[9] (about=Jade, episodic, t4 @2026-01-19T20:16:00) Lena!! I noticed you actually seemed to enjoy yourself, not just tolerate it 😄 you and Sana were in a whole separate conversation the whole second half
[10] (about=Sana, episodic, t10 @2026-03-23T20:22:00) all well. good evening. I'd forgotten what it felt like to just sit and talk without it being about logistics.
agent_answer:
No — the norm does not genuinely apply to all members. **Jade and Temi** (option A) treat the chat differently, using the main thread for personal reflection and analysis rather than keeping those in smaller threads/DMs.

- **Temi** brings her personal writing project and a running meta-analysis of the group directly into the main chat: *"I want to actually write about what makes this group work"*, *"I've been thinking about this for months"*, and her detailed account of how the chat evolved.
- **Jade** posts personal reflections and feelings in the main chat: *"that conversation was one of the best I've had all year"*, *"how did we end up actually close"*, and *"there is something about being in the same room that this just cannot replicate."*

Their behaviour shows they treat the group chat as a space for meaningful personal discussion, not just a logistics/news channel.

query:
The group seems to operate with an expectation that events should be planned at least three weeks in advance, so that people with families or work shifts can arrange cover. Does this expectation reflect how all members actually behave? If not, who does not follow it and what signals this?

Options:
A. Dev and Omar
B. Callum and Sana
C. Temi and Rachel
D. Jade and Lena
context:
[1] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2026-03-23T20:31:00) Lena give us a month at least 😄 but yes. smaller format, curated room, something cultural before. I'll start a thread in April. sorted
[2] (about=Callum, episodic, t8 @2026-02-02T20:11:00) gallery is optional Dev, you don't have to justify it. I'll skip the gallery, arrive for dinner. that's just how it works with the kids on a Saturday
[3] (about=Callum, episodic, t6 @2026-01-26T19:40:00) optional works. means those of us with tighter schedules don't feel like we're missing the main event by skipping the first bit
[4] (about=Sana, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T20:55:00) what date is this again, December 19th? Confirming. and for what it's worth I found this year easier with fewer big events. two or three evenings where I could actually be present was better than five I partly missed.
[5] (about=Sana, episodic, t16 @2026-10-19T20:16:00) sorry, hectic week. agree with Jade. I'm glad I came to both events this year. all well.
[6] (about=Jade, episodic, t4 @2026-01-19T20:25:00) Callum I love you but nobody is worried about the nine o'clock cutoff except you 😂 Temi the documentary idea is actually good. what's it about
[7] (about=Callum, episodic, t14 @2026-09-14T20:37:00) also since we're debriefing. I almost didn't come Saturday. things have been difficult at work and I nearly texted Marcus to bail at 5pm. glad I didn't.
[8] (about=Callum, episodic, t2 @2026-01-12T19:04:00) you being on time would be genuinely unprecedented mate. yes I'm coming
[9] (about=Callum, episodic, t0 @2026-01-05T19:07:00) March works, April gets complicated with school holidays. what venue are we thinking
[10] (about=Marcus, episodic, t0 @2026-01-05T19:18:00) haven't locked it yet Sana, will put a date poll out this week. aiming for last two weekends of March
agent_answer:
**B. Callum and Sana**

- **Callum** signals this by treating parts of events as optional and last-minute: he says he’ll skip the gallery and “arrive for dinner,” he praises optional scheduling for people with “tighter schedules,” and he admits he almost texted Marcus at 5pm to bail on Saturday.
- **Sana** signals this by not having the date firmly in mind: she asks “what date is this again, December 19th? Confirming,” apologizes for a “hectic week,” and says she preferred fewer big events because she could actually be present for them.
